Method of Attack: Exploiting critical vulnerabilities in TerraMaster OS, Zend Framework, and Liferay Portal to upload and execute a Python script (out.py)
Impacted Systems: Liferay Portal Community Edition versions before 7.2.1
Linux devices running vulnerable versions of the above software
Attack Vector: Exploitation of critical remote code execution vulnerabilities (CVE-2020-28188, CVE-2021-3007, CVE-2020-7961)
Downloading malicious Python script from hxxp://gxbrowser[.]net
Use of IRC-based command and control communication
Indicators of Compromise: Modified Darkcomet code listing Fl0urite/Freak as author on Pastebin (January 12, 2021)
